description: Browser SDK for AI-built apps: uptime heartbeat, error capture, session replay, and access gating, reported to BWorlds
rules: Call init() with a buildSlug and nothing else: every other behaviour is configured remotely from the BWorlds dashboard, not from client-side options.
The SDK never breaks the host app. Every feature fails open when the backend is unreachable.
Operator documentation for the bworlds CLI and the SDK install lives at https://docs.bworlds.co/docs.
